message.reasoning_content: Last action round, law follows. Goods don't matter (no more market after? Round 6 market already done). So produce/shuttle useless except law vote? Vote weight = influence+2 if action passed. But I'm president with veto power anyway. Influence affects final 5% bonus — I already have max influence (3). Bribe increases influence but bribe cost transfers to rival — bad. Pass keeps cash and gives +2 vote weight, but I hold presidency (influence 3 vs 2) and can veto anyway. Pass is best.
